title: The open folder
description: `{ path, name, found, boards?, ledger?, ledgers? }`: the folder the board server has open, whose open ledger every other operation reads and writes. With ledger folders it also names that ledger and lists the folder's ledgers.

found.description: True when the folder has a Vision Board: a ledger in `.visionboard/`.

boards.description: How many boards its open ledger holds; given only when `found` is true.

ledger.description: The ledger open now; every other operation reads and writes it. Given only with ledger folders.

ledgers.description: The folder's ledgers, by name. Given only with ledger folders.

folderPath.description: A folder's absolute path on the computer running the board server, as the server gave it

displayName.description: The folder as the person reads it: under the home folder it starts with `~` (`~/projects/example`); elsewhere it is the absolute path

folderHeader.description: A folder's absolute path percent-encoded the way `encodeURI` does it, so the header stays printable ASCII: `/Users/example/My%20projects/a`

entry.description: One folder in a listing: its name, its path and whether it has a Vision Board.

name.description: The folder's own name in a folder's list and in the cloud storage list (`places`); its display name (`~/...`) in the recent list.

hasBoard.description: True when it has a ledger in `.visionboard/`.

ledgerName.description: A ledger's name: its folder in `.visionboard/`; lowercase letters, digits and `-`, like a board id, at most 40 characters, and never the name of a file or folder the board keeps there (`images`, `apps`, `app-state`, `attachments`, `lock`). The first ledger is `main`.
ledgerName.$comment: ledgerFolders flag (LEDGERS_01, D-084 1); data-folder.ts ledgerNameProblem holds the same rule

boards.description: How many boards it holds (0 when its ledger can't be read).

keptOutOfGit.description: True when its folder's `.gitignore` keeps the whole ledger out of git (a throwaway ledger).
